scientific_question: Do matched final-background single/multiple catalytic-group perturbations constrain conditional component effects beyond earlier RA95 lysine relocation?

conclusion.supported: The Y51F/Y180F double has more loss than a multiplicative reference made from the two single-mutant central values in the same RA95.5-8F R-methodol assay. Y180F alone has printed efficiency33600 versus33800 M^-1 s^-1, but the engineered Y51F/Y180F background gives170 versus3400. Its kcat effect also differs by background.
conclusion.bounded_relation: Descriptive parameter-specific nonmultiplicativity of reported outcomes; this is a four-cell paired substitution comparison, not a measured microscopic cooperative mechanism or interaction energy.
not_established: statistical significance or propagated interaction uncertainty
isolated chemical role versus local structural/active-fraction effects
productive geometry, proton-transfer sequence or elementary-step rate
independent human validation, new project experiment or design-success rate
equivalence of near-equal printed single-mutant efficiencies

chemical_state_and_control_limits.reported: Apo5AOU and inhibitor3-complex5AN7 are parentRA95.5-8F structures at1.10angstrom reported resolution. Complex preparation used fivefold inhibitor for2h with2.7%acetonitrile; reported refined inhibitor occupancy75%. Apo crystallization pH4.6 and complex pH7.5 differ. Diffraction data were collected at100K; apo mother liquor contained ammonium sulfate and acetate, while complex mother liquor contained sodium/potassium phosphate andHEPES.
chemical_state_and_control_limits.inference_limit: No deposited coordinates acquired or recalculated in this increment. Parent crystal comparison, inhibitory Schiff-base state and author preorganization/network descriptions do not isolate mutant chemical roles or establish a reacting geometry in solution. Composite steady-state parameters may change their rate-limiting step across mutants; no microscopic coupling energy or binding-affinity interpretation ofKM follows.

chemical_state_and_control_limits.reported: The author describes catalytic-tetrad secondary support from Ser81 and ordered waters; most parent active-site residues overlap between apo/inhibitor models exceptLys83.
chemical_state_and_control_limits.inference_limit: Tetrad is not a demonstrated exhaustive catalytic-apparatus inventory; water/Ser81 contributions, local dynamics and proton assignments remain unresolved.

chemical_state_and_control_limits.reported: ParentTm76C, Y51F71C, Y180F74C, double67C; triple thermal transition not determinable. All seven kinetic rows nevertheless have small or large positive fitted values.
chemical_state_and_control_limits.inference_limit: Thermal support constrains but does not eliminate structural/active-fraction confounding. Do not transfer thermal N.D. to an inactive kinetic label. The double has a9C lower reportedTm than parent; mass consistency and high melting points do not establish purity, active fraction or local mutant structure. K83M has reportedTm82C versus parent76C, constraining gross thermal destabilization without proving an unchanged active site. Thermal rows have no reported uncertainties or exactn.

design_use.usable_constraint: A small single-substitution efficiency response in one evolved background does not justify deleting that group or treating its contribution as independent of the partner residue. HereY180F response is conditional onY51 and on whether the endpoint iskcat or printedkcat/KM.
design_use.specific_added_relation: Four source-bound cells yield an explicit parameter-specific comparison, while the missing Asn cells block a higher-order conclusion; exact source-sequence equality avoids same-name lineage transfer.
design_use.reuse: Existing source/construct/assay/parameter/status/derived-comparison concepts suffice. Two exact sequence providers reused after direct2017 equality checks; no enzyme-specific runtime/schema/validator.
design_use.incumbent_boundary: A competent reader can reproduce the arithmetic from the supplement. Added value is the explicit matched relation and transfer restrictions; no measured curation speedup or superiority over incumbent resources.
design_use.reconsideration: New chemistry did not need bespoke code; factual source curation reused shared concepts. Focus moved from blanket tetrad/cooperation wording to one complete paired comparison and explicit missing combinations. No cross-study activity ranking.
